Notes on Xohn:  
	Order of the Uncarved Block  
![][image1]  
some version of the Order of the Uncarved Block built it many, many years ago perhaps. Started by veterans of the orc purging war and fall of Vontir Empire half a millennia ago. The order changed since then, so the genealogy is shrouded in mystery (of course). The purpose of the order is: find inner peace so as to reflect what they see as balance in the world. They believe that achieving this inner peace will allow the order to return to nature.  (there’s definitely a death drive thing going on). Xohn broke some rule and was sent on a quest to find that balance again. He doesn’t know how to do that though. In addition, there is a branch/subset of the order that goes undercover/spies other organizations. Xohn doesn’t know much about that, however. 

Sir’s background:  
Sir was left on the doorstep of a hut in a small village. With a brusque nature surprising to even the unwashed peasants, Sir eventually outgrew the village, wandering the land. Most of her time wandering was uneventful. It was full of hunting and taking odd jobs for just enough coin. It wasn’t until she entered a lowly tavern one day that her life of adventure began.

# 3/1/25

“It isn't making mistakes that's critical; it's correcting them and getting on with the principal task.” \- Donald Rumsfeld, who lived in agony at the end of his life (a collective yay\!).

* The party stands at the entrance to the cave with the yin-yang symbols.  
* We, as a group, spent a long time talking about life and politics. Ben pointed out that we haven’t yet Orenstein play\!  
* Then we talked about D\&D instead of playing it.  
* Hello AI\!  
* Then we played\! The conjunction of two mountain ridges, where two large slabs converge with a gap, creating the cave with the yin-yang symbol. Xohn’s spiritual journey is at the precipice of another chapter. Sir has provided snacks.  
* Xohn’s initial investigation reveals no additional secrets.  
* The weather begins to turn to rain.  
* After Orenstein dismisses Kim (ruuuuuude; she snaps fingers in the air), Xohn searches for traps.  
* After the entrance, the 20’x30’ room opens up with no moss or lichen, but a breeze (Summer breeze / makes me feel fine / blowing through the jasmine in my miiiinnnnnnddd). The room continues, but it has a shadowy figure in meditation. In the center of the room, something on the floor looks like divots, but could be identified with closer examination.  
* Xohn brings his torch closer to examine the divots. Sir and Orenstein enter cautiously. Buckley noodles on a tune called “Ass of Colossus”.  
* The divots\! A circle with slots.   
* When Xohn steps past, this becomes the cave of the breaking wind\! Smelly. The party must make Athletics checks. Xohn and Sir hold fast, and the torch goes out. The others are blown out.  
* Sir moves against the wind and eventually gets blown out. Xohn settles in to meditate, to go with the flow.  
* Sir and Orenstein cannot make it back into the cave after trying their own ways.  
* Sir says she has solved the puzzle. She says it was difficult, but we have to go… the other way.  
* Xohn is also blown out of the cave. He wonders how they are going to explore the cave.

# 3/9/25

"The wind blows, and then it doesn't blow. And the things cost a fortune. They're made in China, and they kill the birds, and they're horrible." \- President Donald Trump on why this cave sucks (or possibly about windmills?? Could be both. Could be about his stupid mouth).

* After pondering the situation with the air gusts, the mummified monk and the five points in the ground, the party decides to move deeper into the cave.  
* Sir and Buckley lead the party forward. They “hop” down to find a giant toad. The toad ignores Sir’s offering of a ration, but when she goes to retrieve her ration, Sir is attacked by the giant toad\! She attacks in return, and the fight is on. Xohn brings the torch forward, throwing darts. Orenstein lands a huge eldrich blast, chunking out a part of the toad’s head. It’s rubbery form is repulsive. Orenstein’s familiar, Kim the sprite, goes invisible.  
* The toad’s gross tongue latches on to Sir, reeling her into its poisonous maw. A second toad enters the fray, plopping in next to Kim.  
* Buckley’s thunderwave damages the toad, but it remains in place. He also gives the party temporary hit points.  
* Orenstein has blasted it again\! Xohn kicks the toad, it kicks back\! Xohn’s torch is extinguished, and Kim’s new audience of five disappears in the darkness. The toad resists being ensmallened by Buckley’s magic.  
* Sir chops and kills the toad, and Xohn is released from his prison inside the Toad’s mouth. Xohn is grateful. Sir flies down  with the spirit of an eagle, yelling “MORE FROGS\!” The rest of the party is confused in the darkness.   
* The frog-reptile people begin to surround Sir. But Buckley jumps down and wheels around for optimal breath weapon placement. Four are trapped in the range of a lightning bolt springing forth from Buckley’s mouth. Sir strikes one of those victim’s down, looping around with the grace of an eagle to put herself between Buckley and the frog-reptile creatures.  
* The frog-reptile-men unleash a flurry of furious attacks, severely damaging Sir and targeting Buckley’s liver.  
* Kim moves the torch to where Orenstein is granted vision. Orenstein casts Phantasmal Force. Xohn leaps down, runs up and the GOAT strikes down two of the frog-reptile people. It’s kicks galore for these stinky foes\!  
* The battle rages on. Sir and Xohn are dropping foes. Buckley is deftly staying out of harm’s way, causing the foes to be subject to emotional rollercoasters and trauma triggers. Orenstein’s illusions are beguiling foes. Despite being armed with shortswords, these foes are finding themselves overwhelmed. Three foes have fled, the rest are bleeding out.  
* Xohn has been hit again, he’s fading fast. Buckley comes in with a huge healing spell, bring Xohn to full. Only for another frog-reptile stabbing Xohn once more.   
* With time having run out on our players, the battle ends on a cliffhanger\! 

# 3/15/25

“We will, in fact, be greeted as liberators.” \- Dick Cheney, whose experiences with giant toads and horrible stenches is innumerable.

“Never trust a Hippie. We said it a long time ago and it’s not really changed. And these are hippies with laptops.” \- John Lydon

* HAHA Xohn kicks and kills a frog-reptile.  
* Xohn is severely hurt after being attached by frog-reptile and clawed.  
* Buckley “cure wounds” on Xohn\! Whew\! He is cured.  
* Sir strikes the trog in the chest with her axe, and Orenstein “shoots toads in a barrel” with Eldritch Blast\!   
* The laughing trog is hit by Xohn, stops laughing, and stands up only to be put down by Sir and Xohn.  
* Buckley sneaks ahead to scout out the cavernous drop. It extends down beyond his darkvision. Wind rises up from the drop, an ominous sound indicating large airflows.  
* Sir discovers a symbol/rune on the short sword after investigation. Orenstein decodes the symbol as “venomous fang.”  
*  The party makes their way around the deep pit. They find a stinky bog, with trickling water, with humanoid bones in the distance. Orenstein casts a spell to fetch a skull. His casting draws forth energy from the far realm, and gives him a ghastly glow, channeling death itself. The group identifies the skull as having been eaten and the brains slurped out, and it was some type of elf\!   
* The group finds a backpack. Inside: 3 climber's kit; 3 silken ropes; 6 gems; scroll tube; 2 potions; pouch containing strange coins with a hole in the middle, a plaque of gold (50), 12 leather straps with coins of silver (50 sp each)  
* A spider coin\! A spider on one side, a web on the other.   
* The party moves around the deep pit, and finds deliberate architecture (by Frank Lloyd Wright).  
* A fish clops along down the hall, wielding a claw-topped staff. It sees the party and attacks\! But the party drives it away, and it left in deliberate architecture, wondering where it came from and who built it and why?


# 3/16/25

“He told me that my fish was swimming in the clear blue waters in heaven and he would never tire and he would never get hungry and he would never be in any danger and he could swim as far and wide as he wanted and he never had to stop, because the river went on forever. He was free.”  \- Patti Reagan, on what her father told her about the fish priest.

* We begin in initiative, as the party is left to pursue the fish-man or explore their new, deliberately-constructed scenarios.  
* Buckley moves ahead to find a large bearded face\! It’s on the wall. The stonework is impressive.  
* Buckley shouts, “I am upon him\!” He has caught up to the fish person\!  
* The fish-person flees into a room, and a clatter emerges.  
* While Sir covers the flank, Buckley casts Thunderwave blindly into the room\! The fish-person and a dark figure are targeted\! The dark figure is holding a longbow, whose arrow was the source of clatter.  
* The fish-person is horrified to learn Sir has flanked, and the fish-person dies at the end of the horrific greataxe attack.  
* Loot: He has a pouch of fish food pellets, a staff with a pincher, a cast iron hook, some rope.  
* Suddenly, we look into our stuff: “Hey guys, what do we have?” “I wonder if Orenstein has been hoarding everything. You *know* how he likes to do that.”  
  * Scroll and 10 gold pieces (old vontir coins, yet we don’t know)  
  * Scroll ley line navigation (orenstein)  
  * Scroll how to fly (o)  
  * 5 gem stones green yellow red, gold deep blue and silver dagger (X)  
  * Silk flying cloak ying yang, the thing we flew on. (x)  
  * Small wooden figurine that was a crude dragon   
  * Quarterstaff with scorch marks (o)  
  * Tinderbox and 10 torches  
  * Journal of Dungeon layouts (o)  
  * 2nd potion of healing (Sir)  
  * Leather armor with features and small bones on it)  
  * Wooden shield (Sir)  
  * Potion of flying (orenstein)  
  * Xohn has 2 kama (kama, kama, kamakamleon; he comes and goes, he comes and gooooooooooeeeeesss)  
* An investigation into the bearded ceiling face. Xohn recognizes the figure from a historical book. Likely dwarven, perhaps Moradin? History of Hebbock from after the wars. Maybe northeastern wars Orc wars.  
* Xohn demonstrates to Sir that the fish-people and dwarves have more in common than she thought, and that we all have a great deal more in common than she thought. Sir realizes by killing the fish person, she has in fact killed a part of herself. The bearded man in the ceiling has provided her great wisdom.  
* The party finds a room for resting. Orenstein opens the door to a second room with shrieking fungus\! Its high-pitched wail attracts some horrible huge goblin that attacks Sir twice with a greatsword. The creature retreats after Orenstein’s powerful fire illusion. Sir moves to close the door, but somehow is outflanked. The creature attacks the illusory copy of Kim, much to its disappointment. This gives Sir an opening to chop her battleaxe deep into its shoulder. Xohn runs in with kicks galore\!  
* Sir takes another hit, and fails to retaliate, actually throwing her battleaxe down the hall. In the battle, Xohn’s kick galore strikes purchase into its skull, dropping the creature to the ground.  
* Coins with an eye on one side and sword on another.  
* A long rest\!
